original.target_description: Title and DOI verified in the supplied cached primary paper. New locator p. 15 identifies Table 8, hierarchical linear regressions of individual tokens invested in bandwidth. It reports three treatment columns (2 persons, 5 persons, and 5 persons (b)), with separate coefficients for lagged downloading share, its interaction with position, position, and round, plus variance-component tests. The locator does not identify a coefficient/test or treatment; study and outcome description remain absent. Thus the target sample and test cannot be uniquely matched.

replication.target_description: Author report at supplied OSF file verified against Janssen et al. (2011) and project title at referenced OSF node p9k76. It highlights the lagged share by position interaction in the mixed-effects investment regression (Table 3), with alternative specifications in Table 4. No assigned locator, description, or study identifier establishes which reported effect belongs to audit_id 2094.

reported_success.quote: The replication of the research claim of Janssen et al. (2011) was successful.

notes: Both full primary papers were acquired and titles verified; neither is unavailable. Input locators_o and locators_r are empty, description and study identifiers are null, and es_type is only ser_method. Following the empty-locator rule, no target-specific statistic or analytic sample was selected. The report identifies its focal claim, but assigning that claim to this audit effect would require an unsupported choice without an input locator. Reported success is the author's overall narrative verdict on that claim, not an independently inferred target-test verdict. Original source: OpenAlex best_oa_location, Indiana University repository publisher-formatted PDF. Replication source: supplied OSF a6nsp/download PDF; OSF node lookup for a6nsp returned 404 because this is a file, while referenced project p9k76 title matched. No numerical conversions performed. Locator-enriched revisit: examined the newly supplied original locator p. 15 (PDF page 15, Table 8). It narrows the original to individual investment regressions but does not specify a treatment column or coefficient/test. Multiple analytic Ns and tests remain possible, so original remains locator_insufficient with null statistics rather than selecting one without support. The Table 8 caption labels bracketed entries p values, although several exceed 1; no bracketed entry was adopted as a p value. Replication locator remains empty, so that side was not revisited. Previously completed author verdict and replication record preserved unchanged. No acquisition attempted and no unchanged paper miss retried.
